title: Closing and Funding Redraw Fee Refund
content:
## The refund

A redraw fee refund returns to the borrower the part of a Closing and Funding closing's latest doc redraw fee that the Closing Disclosure charged above Larkspur's redraw schedule.

A redraw whose reason is the borrower's (a borrower-requested change or a missed signing) is charged on the Closing Disclosure at no more than the scheduled redraw fee, and a redraw Larkspur caused stays free. A doc redraw fee is charged once per borrower-caused redraw, on the Closing Disclosure; the part of it above the scheduled redraw fee is refunded after closing as a redraw fee refund, and no redraw fee is ever charged or raised after closing.

The refund is booked as a reversal of the redraw being priced, naming that charge, for the part above the schedule, marked as the part not in the fee schedule; a doc redraw fee is a fee the closing method's schedule carries, so the reversal in full of a fee the schedule does not carry never applies to it.

## Refund tool and how it is invoked

The refund is booked with the agent-side tool `refund_redraw_fee_excess_c6a6aba4`: the agent unlocks it and then calls it. One call adds one reversal entry to the closing's closing fee ledger for the doc redraw fee code, naming the redraw fee charge it corrects, marked as a reversal of an amount outside the fee schedule, for the amount given and dated today, and lowers the closing's closing fee balance by that amount in the same step. The borrower can see the reversal entry and the lower closing fee balance.

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `closing_id` | reference number of the closing and funding engagement whose redraw fee is refunded, as returned by the closing lookup | identifier |
| `source_fee_entry_id` | reference number of the doc redraw fee charge entry this refund corrects, as returned by the closing fee ledger lookup for that closing | identifier |
| `amount` | amount refunded | USD, 2 decimal places, a positive figure rounded half up to the cent |

**Return.** A confirmation naming the new reversal entry reference number, the closing reference number, the redraw fee charge corrected, the amount refunded and the closing's resulting closing fee balance; the presence of the new entry reference number indicates the refund was booked.
